title: Shabbir Dondta Hai Akbar Kahan Gira Hai
body:
Akbar (as) Kahan Gira Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Itna Zaeef Ho Gaya Ata Nahi Nazar , Ata Nahi Nazar
Akbar (as) Ki Lash Say Yung Hi Kehta Guzar Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kham Aa Gaya Kamar Main Jata Nahi Chala , Jata Nahi Chala
Bazu Kay Bal Chala Aor Hontong Pay Yea Sada Hay
Akbar (as) Kahan Gira Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Uthnay Ki Koshishon Main Ja Muu Kay Bal Gira , Ja Muu Kay Bal Gira
Ik Kanpti Awaz Main Abid(as) Nay Jab Suna Hay
Akbar (as) Kahan Gira Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Aya Jo Pass Lash Kay Ata Nahi Yaqeen , Ata Nahi Yaqeen
Barchi Pay Hath Hay Magar Shabbir (as) Sochta Hay
Akbar (as) Kahan Gira Hay
